name: Versatility
description: +1 prepared slot, and companion-granted spells cost no off-caster tax. Breadth over signature.

name: Minor Working
description: Choose one: heal 3 party HP · chart 1 adjacent unseen hex · no terrain drain for 3 steps.

name: Emulate
description: Recast the last spell cast this expedition at its cost +1. Inherits the original's magnitude and echoes.

name: Attuned Recall
description: The bearing and distance of your staging point and the nearest anchor, from anywhere afield.
